description: This Java class defines a custom Liquibase changeset for creating coded order frequencies for drug order frequencies in the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for executing database updates, inserting unique frequency entries, handling errors, and generating UUIDs for new entries.

classes.name: CreateCodedOrderFrequencyForDrugOrderFrequencyChangeset
classes.description: A Liquibase custom task class implementing logic to create and insert unique medication order frequency concepts into the database, with handling for UUID generation and error management.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked to perform the database changeset execution, retrieving unique frequencies and inserting them into the database.

methods.name: insertUniqueFrequencies
methods.description: Inserts unique frequency values into the order_frequency table, generating UUIDs, mapping concepts, and handling transaction control.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles database errors by rolling back transactions and throwing custom exceptions.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message after successful execution.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the task; no setup required in this implementation.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Sets resource accessor; not used in this implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the database before running; returns null indicating no validation errors.
